🚨 WE’RE HIRING | Senior Data Engineer / Data Engineer HashedIn by Deloitte 🚨
📍 Locations: Bangalore, Mumbai, Kolkata, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai

🧠 Experience: 1.3 to 7.5 YearsAre you passionate about building scalable data pipelines, working with cloud-native architectures, and delivering real-time analytics solutions? This is your opportunity to be a part of a high-growth, product-focused engineering team at HashedIn by Deloitte.🔧 Key Skills We’re Looking For:✅ Spark (Scala/Python), SQL, PySpark
✅ Airflow / Prefect / Luigi
✅ Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure) – S3, Redshift, BigQuery, Databricks
✅ Data modeling (Star/Snowflake), Data Warehousing, and Lakehouse
✅ Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, batch jobs
✅ Familiarity with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, CI/CD pipelines
✅ Data Governance, Lineage, Security (GDPR/CCPA), Observability💼 What You’ll Work On:🚀 Design, build, and optimize modern cloud data platforms
🧱 Architect and scale data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses
📊 Collaborate with analysts, ML engineers, and DevOps
🔐 Implement best practices in data privacy, security, compliance🧠 Culture HashedIn by Deloitte Work with the agility of a startup and the impact of an enterprise
Extreme ownership, fast-paced learning, and a fun tech culture
A place for problem solvers, builders, and learners
📩 Interested? Here’s how to apply:
👉 Drop your email ID in the comments.
👉 You'll receive a link to upload your CV and fill your details.Let’s build the future of data together!Tag a friend or colleague who’d be a great fit 💥
